system.description:
Roll 1D, and then acquire the designated effect for the result: [1: (Attack Power) +2] [2: (Magic Power) +2] [3: (Physical Defense) +4] [4: (Magical Defense) +4] [5: [Initiative] +4] [6: [Starting Fate Point] +2]. This effect lasts until the end of the scenario.

(CR16): Increase the bonus of each listed effect by double.

A special technique that releases the power of change in the tail and randomly obtains various blessings.
